rule: ready / carrier-unresolved is evidence's status from the reviewed handoff, copied verbatim. A ready row means the existing provider-documented claims name the carrier; it is not a product contract. Core #1223-#1226 are open, so no row has an adopted product contract: expectations come only from the handoff slot. carrier-unresolved is not a false negative, true negative or passing coverage.
